name: bead
description: Vertical exclusive picker for a short ordered list. A bead slides on a shared track; the selected label comes forward and the others recede.
avoidWhen: Do not use for unordered categories, long lists, or binary on/off — use a list, radios, or a switch.

ux.behaviour: The bead sits on the current option; that label is bright and the others recede
ux.why: You can read the choice without hunting for a filled circle

ux.behaviour: The bead slides along the track to the option you tap
ux.why: The choice should feel like moving along a scale, not flipping a radio
ux.reducedMotion: The bead jumps; labels still update

ux.behaviour: The whole row is the hit target
ux.why: You tap the words, not a 20 dp bead

aiHints: Options must be ordered (never → sometimes → always), not a bag of categories
Keep 2–5 options; more than five is a list
The whole row is the hit target, not the bead
Caller owns selectedIndex; do not store it inside
